rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s multi-part request or adhere to policy. While it looked up the user and some orders, it executed two exchange write actions without any explicit user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. It did not address all requested changes: there’s no evidence of exchanging the camera, nor handling the skateboard cancellation request (even to acknowledge the user would do it themselves). The agent also did not verify or confirm that the payment method used was the requested Visa card, and provided no final details summarizing what was changed. The closing message implies completion without demonstrating the necessary authenticated, confirmed, and correct actions across all items, so this fails the pass bar.
